keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Cameron Bragg (Southampton) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match (Southampton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
First Half ends, Southampton 0, Derby County 0.
Substitution, Southampton. Kuryu Matsuki replaces Cameron Bragg.
Second Half begins Southampton 0, Derby County 0.
David Ozoh (Derby County) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Southampton 1, Derby County 0. Cyle Larin (Southampton) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Finn Azaz.
Substitution, Derby County. Henrik Meister replaces Mohammed Fuseini.
Substitution, Southampton. Lewis Dobbin replaces Samuel Edozie.
Substitution, Southampton. Divin Mubama replaces Cyle Larin.
Substitution, Derby County. Lars-Jørgen Salvesen replaces Carlton Morris.
Substitution, Derby County. Oscar Fraulo replaces David Ozoh.
Substitution, Derby County. Filip Bilbija replaces Bobby Clark.
Delay in match (Southampton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Southampton. Mads Roerslev replaces Tom Fellows.
Delay in match because of an injury Henrik Meister (Derby County).
Substitution, Derby County. Corey Blackett-Taylor replaces Henrik Meister because of an injury.
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Southampton 2, Derby County 0. Divin Mubama (Southampton) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Lewis Dobbin following a fast break.
Second Half ends, Southampton 2, Derby County 0.
